page.layout: One page, title page. Centred lines of large capitals, then a dedication in italic lines set right of centre, then the author's name in capitals. Faint show-through of the reverse side and a library stamp at the foot are not printed matter on this page.
page.notes: The faint, mirrored text in the upper half (large ghost letters such as "PRÆMISSIONE" and "DISPUTATIO") and the faint imprint lines in the lower centre (around "Excudebat" and a date) appear to be show-through from the reverse side, so they are not transcribed. The imprint lines are too blurred to read reliably in any case. The library stamp at the very foot is excluded. "Hancce" is read from the italic type and is slightly uncertain.
